expo.name: Tentacle TV
expo.description: Tentacle TV is a premium media client for self-hosted media servers. Stream your movies, series, and music from your personal library with a beautiful, native iOS experience.

infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Tentacle TV needs access to your local network to connect to your self-hosted media server.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tentacle TV does not use the camera. This entry is required because the video playback library (FFmpeg) includes a capture module that is never called.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Tentacle TV does not use the microphone. This entry is required because the video playback library (FFmpeg) includes a capture module that is never called.
